'''Pokémon Adventures: Evolution Action''' is the 25th monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters 17, 18, and 19 of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|5}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

* {{adv|Yellow}} saves everyone on board the [[S.S. Anne]].
* The S.S. Anne sinks in the {{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}}.
* Yellow is told about the legend of the Vermilion Harbor by the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]].
* {{adv|Green}} tries to convince {{adv|Bill}} to let her use his Pokémon Storage System.
